# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is a simple demonstration project for learning about forking and pull requests on GitHub.

## Project Overview

This is a basic HTML/CSS website project (derived from the classic Spoon-Knife repository) that serves as an example for:
- Forking repositories
- Making simple changes
- Submitting pull requests
- Learning GitHub workflow

## Project Structure

- `index.html` - Main HTML page
- `styles.css` - Stylesheet for the page
- `README.md` - Project documentation
- Other markdown files for documentation purposes

## Code Style Guidelines

### HTML
- Use proper HTML5 doctype
- Maintain consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Use semantic HTML where applicable
- Keep code clean and readable

### CSS
- Use consistent formatting
- Group related styles together
- Prefer readable selector names
- Keep specificity low when possible

## Development Practices

- Keep changes minimal and focused
- Ensure HTML validates properly
- Test any changes by opening `index.html` in a browser
- Maintain the simplicity of the project - this is meant to be a learning resource

## Important Notes

- This is a demonstration/educational repository
- Changes should maintain backward compatibility
- Keep the project accessible to beginners
- Preserve the original purpose: teaching Git and GitHub basics
